method: Shared exact coordinate vertices; UI default assumes line endpoints at equal coordinates connect across layer tags, with strict-layer sensitivity option. No geometric intersection splitting or snapping. Haversine metres; Dijkstra distance; edge-state Dijkstra minimum cumulative absolute bearing change in degrees, metres tie-break.

referenceLabels.local-Wcross2: 西路中南段参照附近路网点

restrictions: Exclude access=no/private; pedestrian excludes motorway/trunk; service scenario excludes footway/path/steps/cycleway/pedestrian/bridleway and respects oneway when present. Missing tags are unknown, not permission.
closure: User-selected edge removed only in an illustrative sensitivity scenario. Not a measured seasonal or water-based closure.
limitations: Source extract does not preserve original OSM node identifiers; shared coordinate is a topology proxy, not confirmed junction.

Same-position crossings can have unknown vertical separation. Default shared-coordinate line-endpoint joins are an explicit hypothesis. Strict-layer option can artificially disconnect bridge/tunnel approaches.
No legal access, fence, gate, current surface, actual traffic, animal behavior or bearing-capacity survey.
Road tags and timestamps represent a frozen mixed-date extract, not any selected historical lake month.
Straight office connector is a candidate assumption, not a measured path or construction recommendation.
No formal space-syntax integration/choice, visibility graph, normalized centrality or CFD is computed.
angularCost: Sum smallest absolute heading differences at every source vertex; not formal space-syntax integration/choice. Geometry resolution affects cost.
